I'm a [Professor of Psychology](#0) at the University of Oslo. I lead a
lab investigating biological systems that link psychological and social
factors to health, with a focus on neuroendocrine systems and the
autonomic nervous system. My lab uses various research approaches,
including intranasal oxytocin studies, large-scale genetics studies,
neuroimaging, and the collection of autonomic nervous system data.

## Research interests

- The role of the oxytocin system in health and wellbeing
- Cardiac psychophysiology
- Evidence synthesis
- Meta-science
